name: mios_task_record
description: One line of tasks.jsonl at the MiOS repo root, the only canonical MiOS task list (ADR-0028, supersedes ADR-0026). The path comes from mios.toml [tasks.store].path. Lines are serialized like Python json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False): separators ', ' and ': ', keys in the order of 'required' below, so the dev-loop toolkit and mios-task rewrite a line identically. Status words are the OpenAI plan statuses. Overrides are not part of a record: they are JSON lines in the TASKS.md overrides block, each an id plus record fields applied on top of the record.

id.description: Unique in the file; kept verbatim from the retired lists and never reminted. A '#n' suffix marks a second, different task that carried the same id in a retired list.

type.description: The retired store type roadmap_item maps to task; the original type is kept in provenance.type_raw.

owner.description: Lane claim such as claude-code, lane-b or Codex. An empty string means unclaimed. Never free-form 'Who' text.

epic.description: The id of an epic record, or an empty string.

depends_on.description: Blocking edges only. Every entry must resolve to an id in the file.

verification_evidence.description: Must be non-empty when status is completed.

provenance.description: null for a record created in tasks.jsonl; such a record must have non-empty acceptance_criteria plus verification.positive_cmd and verification.negative_control_cmd. A migrated record carries where it came from and every byte it owned in the retired lists.

key.description: The record's key in the retired TASKS.jsonl, or its id in the lane file

aliases.description: Former ids and keys this record answered to

owner_raw.description: The store's 'Who' text; never a lane claim

sources.description: The verbatim slices of the retired lists this record owned, in file order. Concatenated by offset, the slices of every record rebuild each file of mios.toml [tasks.store].frozen byte for byte (mios-task source).

offset.description: Byte offset of the slice in its file

after.description: The id of the record that owns the slice just before this one in the same file; empty for the first slice. Names a dropped record.
